parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. You can view the application ID on the [Application Management](~~2355593~~) page of ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. The query granularity must be ≥ 5 minutes and ≤ 31 days. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity for querying data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

- 300
- 3600
- 86400

If this parameter is not specified or set to an unsupported value, the default value 3600 is used.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
